```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(assertr)

source("0-context.R")
```

# Components

## SALURBAL


The [`harmonized__salurbal_din__v1` data model](https://ccuh-dbt.netlify.app/#!/model/model.ccuh_datawarehouse.harmonized__salurbal_din__v1?g_v=1&g_i=%2Bharmonized__salurbal_din__v1%2B) was used to operationalize desired SALURBAL Death counts. 

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Create aggregate data for L2 for over/under 65."

## Connect to hamronized DIN database v1
db_harmonized__salurbal_din__v1 = '//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/dev/harmonized__salurbal_din__v1.parquet' %>% 
  arrow::open_dataset() |> 
  rename(date = dod, age = dinage ) 

## L2 counts
df_L2 <- db_harmonized__salurbal_din__v1  %>% 
  summarize(death = n(), .by = c(salid2, date)) |> 
  collect() %>% 
  complete(salid2, date, fill = list(death = 0)) |> 
  arrange(salid2, date)

## L2 by age group counts
df_L2_age <- db_harmonized__salurbal_din__v1 |> 
  mutate(age_category = ifelse(age <= 64, "<65", "65+")) |> 
  summarize(death = n(), .by = c(salid2, date, age_category)) |> 
  collect() %>% 
  complete(salid2, date, age_category,
           fill = list(death = 0)) |> 
  arrange(salid2, date)
```

Limitations note -  that PA is missing almost half of counts due to missing `DAY` coded as 98 or 99 - these are collapsed in to date of `NA`.


## USA

This will pull from the [`base__pennsylvania_recrods_death_v1` data model](https://ccuh-dbt.netlify.app/#!/model/model.ccuh_datawarehouse.base__pennsylvania_records_death_v1?g_v=1&g_i=%2Bbase__pennsylvania_records_death_v1%2B).

```{r}

## Connect to data model 
db_base__pennsylvania_records_death_v1 = '//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/dev/base__pennsylvania_records_death_v1.parquet' %>% 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  rename(date = dod, age = age_death )


## DSPH Neighborhood counts
df_phl_nbhd <- db_base__pennsylvania_records_death_v1  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(geoid_dsph_nbhd)) %>% 
  summarize(death = n(), .by = c(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date)) |> 
  collect() %>% 
  complete(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date, fill = list(death = 0)) |> 
  arrange(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date) 

## DSPH Neighborhood counts by age
df_phl_nbhd_age <- db_base__pennsylvania_records_death_v1 |>
 filter(!is.na(geoid_dsph_nbhd)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(age)) %>% 
  mutate(age_category = ifelse(age <= 64, "<65", "65+")) |> 
  summarize(death = n(), .by = c(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date, age_category)) |> 
  collect() %>% 
  complete(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date, age_category,
           fill = list(death = 0)) |> 
  arrange(geoid_dsph_nbhd, date) 
```

- Note that Pennsylvania death records had 1,197 (our of > 3 million records) that was missing age; these were filtered out of the age specific death counts table


# Harmonized

Now let's combine these two types of counts


## Counts

```{r}

## SALURBAL
df_mort_salurbal = df_L2 %>% 
  left_join(xwalk_l2 %>% select(salid2, iso2, salid1, salid1_name))%>% 
  mutate(geo = 'L2', city_geo = 'L1AD') %>% 
  select(iso2, city_geo, city_geoid = salid1, city_name = salid1_name,
         subcity_geo = geo, subcity_geoid = salid2,  date, 
         subcity_death = death)


## Philadelphia
df_mort_usa = df_phl_nbhd %>% 
  mutate(geo = 'DSPH Nbhd',
         iso2 = 'US', 
         city_geo = 'county10',
         city_geoid = '42101', 
         city_name = 'Philadelphia County')%>% 
  select(iso2, city_geo, city_geoid , city_name ,
         subcity_geo = geo, subcity_geoid = geoid_dsph_nbhd ,  date, 
         subcity_death = death)


## Harmonized
df_mort = bind_rows(df_mort_salurbal, df_mort_usa) %>% 
  verify(!is_null(subcity_geoid))%>% 
  verify(!is_null(city_geoid))
df_mort %>% arrow::write_parquet(context$df_mort)
```

Let's preview

```{r}
df_mort %>% 
  group_by(iso2) %>% 
  slice(1:2) 
```


## Counts by age 

```{r}

## SALURBAL
df_mort_age_salurbal = df_L2_age %>% 
  left_join(xwalk_l2 %>% select(salid2, iso2, salid1, salid1_name))%>% 
  mutate(geo = 'L2', city_geo = 'L1AD') %>% 
  select(iso2, city_geo, city_geoid = salid1, city_name = salid1_name,
         subcity_geo = geo, subcity_geoid = salid2,  date, age_category,
         subcity_death = death)


## Philadelphia
df_mort_age_usa = df_phl_nbhd_age %>% 
  mutate(geo = 'DSPH Nbhd',
         iso2 = 'US', 
         city_geo = 'county10',
         city_geoid = '42101', 
         city_name = 'Philadelphia County')%>% 
  select(iso2, city_geo, city_geoid , city_name ,
         subcity_geo = geo, subcity_geoid = geoid_dsph_nbhd ,  date, 
        age_category, subcity_death = death)


## Harmonized
df_mort_age = bind_rows(df_mort_age_salurbal, df_mort_age_usa) %>% 
  verify(!is_null(subcity_geoid))%>% 
  verify(!is_null(city_geoid))
df_mort_age %>% arrow::write_parquet(context$df_mort_age)
```

Let's preview

```{r}
df_mort_age %>% 
  group_by(iso2) %>% 
  slice(1:2)  
```

# Access

```{{r}}
df_mort =  "`r context$df_mort`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
  
df_mort_age =  "`r context$df_mort_age`" |> 
  arrow::open_dataset() %>% 
  dplyr::collect()
```
